description: PRISM 2, our most thorough lab reading: the model reasons over the whole panel, an independent reviewer checks it, and it is revised if needed. Returns a health picture (the story in plain words, connections graded Established / Likely / Worth asking, questions for the doctor with urgency, tests that are due, safety notes, what is unknown) plus the same recommendations shape as explain_my_lab_results. Returns a job_id at once; the reading usually takes 30–60 seconds. Call get_lab_analysis with the job_id after about 30 seconds; it says "pending" until the result is ready, and keeps the result for 30 minutes. Made-up or de-identified values only: never names, dates or record numbers.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 7.6 }. Made-up or de-identified only.

name: start_lab_analysis
title: Start a lab-results analysis and collect it later (made-up or de-identified numbers)
